capabilities: Format the code block where the cursor is located
Check code syntax before formatting with prettier-backed languages
Bypass syntax checks by using a js-beautify-backed language
extras: The README lists a supported-language table mapping each language to its formatter (prettier or js-beautify-based module) and warns that the Markdown syntax of the code block must be correct before formatting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format or beautify code inside a fenced code block in a note.
summary: Code formatter that beautifies the fenced code block containing the cursor via a command palette command.
